glyph_origin: Unclear. One hypothesis derives 冬 from the antenna-like upper part of an oracle-bone graph formerly read as 鼉 (“crocodilian”) (e.g. 合集 6163反, 7405反), but reinterpreted as 螽 (“katydid; locust”). The word may be related to 統(“thread-end; leading strand of silk”) and 終.
senses: (HKC, cha chaan teng, jargon) alternative form of 凍
